hero.label: Services
hero.headline: Our technical BIM integration capabilities.
hero.subheadline: Each service is a layer of the integration system we build for high-complexity projects: Electrical Systems, BMS, Telecommunications, Security and more.

items.title: BIM Integration
items.shortDescription: We connect Electrical Systems, BMS, Telecommunications and Security into a coordinated, constructible federated model.
items.description: BIM integration goes beyond modeling. It involves articulating technical information from Electrical Systems (Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, Power, Lighting, Grounding, Lightning Protection), BMS, Telecommunications and Electronic Security in a controlled, traceable environment aligned to client requirements.
benefits: Federated model with consistent and traceable electrical, mechanical and special systems information
Interference reduction between electrical systems, piping and structure before construction
Alignment between electrical design, systems engineering and construction
Verifiable deliverables under ISO 19650 standards

useCases.description: Integration of medium and low voltage electrical systems, BMS and industrial automation in plants.
Coordination of uninterruptible power, electrical distribution and critical systems.
Integration of medical systems, special electrical, gases and security.

items.title: BIM Coordination
items.shortDescription: Interference detection and resolution — electrical, mechanical and structural — before they reach the construction site.
items.description: BIM coordination is the systematic process of identifying, documenting and resolving inter-discipline conflicts before construction. SORA implements structured coordination workflows under BCF and CDE, with special focus on interferences between electrical, mechanical and structural systems.
benefits: Early detection of interferences between electrical, mechanical and structural systems
Documented and traceable BCF workflows by discipline
RFI and change request reduction in the field
Technical coordination meetings with structured agenda

useCases.description: Coordination of underground electrical installations and structural systems.
Architectural, electrical, structural and special systems coordination.
Coordination of electrical systems, piping, structure and automation.

items.title: Special Systems
items.shortDescription: BIM for BMS, Telecommunications, Electronic Security, Industrial Controls and Automation.
items.description: Special systems are frequently the weak link in BIM coordination. SORA specializes in integrating BMS, Telecommunications, CCTV, Access Control, Fire Suppression, Industrial Controls and Automation into the federated model, coordinated with electrical systems and structure.
benefits: Precise modeling of BMS, Telecommunications, Security and Industrial Controls
Coordination with electrical systems, structure, architecture and MEP
Technical documentation aligned to manufacturer specifications
Deliverables for installation, commissioning and maintenance

useCases.description: BMS, environmental monitoring, cooling systems, UPS and electrical distribution.
Nurse call systems, communications, security and clinical networks.
SCADA, PLC, Industrial Controls, automation and safety systems.

items.title: Electrical Systems BIM
items.shortDescription: BIM integration of Medium Voltage, Low Voltage, Power, Lighting, Grounding and Lightning Protection.
items.description: Electrical systems are the backbone of any high-complexity project. SORA integrates all levels into BIM: from Medium Voltage substations to Low Voltage distribution, Power circuits, interior and exterior Lighting, Grounding systems and Lightning Protection — all coordinated with other project disciplines.
benefits: BIM modeling of substations, panels and Medium/Low Voltage electrical pathways
Coordination between Power, Lighting, Grounding and Lightning Protection with structure and architecture
Electrical interference detection before field installation
Complete technical documentation for regulatory compliance and maintenance

useCases.description: Medium voltage substations, plant electrical distribution, industrial lighting and grounding systems.
Redundant electrical distribution, PDUs, critical grounding systems and lightning protection.
Public lighting, underground distribution networks and protection systems.

items.title: Information Management
items.shortDescription: Information governance from EIR to digital asset delivery.
items.description: BIM information management under ISO 19650 requires defined processes, owners and tools from the start. SORA implements the complete chain: AIR → OIR → PIR → EIR → BEP → TIDP → MIDP → IFC.
benefits: Documented information governance framework
Configured and operational CDE structure
Nomenclature and classification under standard
Revision and approval traceability

useCases.description: Compliance with institutional information requirements.
Digital asset management for operations and maintenance.
Certifiable technical documentation for operators.

items.title: BIM 4D
items.shortDescription: Construction scheduling linked to the BIM model. Construction simulation.
items.description: BIM 4D integrates the time dimension into the 3D model to simulate the construction process, identify sequence conflicts and optimize construction planning.
benefits: Visual simulation of the construction process
Sequence conflict identification before construction
Workforce and resource optimization
Effective communication of the construction plan

useCases.description: Plant shutdown planning with minimal production impact.
Construction sequences in projects with active traffic.
Phased construction with operational continuity.

items.title: BIM 5D
items.shortDescription: Cost control integrated with the BIM model. Automated quantification and budgeting.
items.description: BIM 5D links the model with cost information to generate automated quantity takeoffs, reliable budgets and real-time cost control during construction.
benefits: Automated model-based quantity takeoff
More accurate and faster budgets
Cost control integrated with actual progress
Reduced uncertainty in estimates

useCases.description: Early estimates for investment decisions.
Cost control in projects with high system variability.
Budgeting for electrical installations and special systems.

items.tagline: Zero tolerance for errors. Integration with no margin for failure.
items.description: Data centers demand the highest level of electrical and systems coordination. Redundant power distribution, critical grounding, BMS, environmental monitoring and security systems must be integrated with zero margin for error.

items.title: Hospitals
items.tagline: Medical systems, special electrical and security integrated without interference.
items.description: Hospital projects combine mission-critical electrical installations (Normal Power, Emergency Power, Medical UPS) with special systems such as medical gases, nurse call, imaging and security.

items.title: Commercial
items.tagline: High-density coordination in mixed-use and corporate projects.
items.description: Commercial and corporate projects combine multiple disciplines on tight schedules. SORA coordinates Lighting, Power, BMS and Security electrical systems with architecture, structure and plumbing.

items.title: Infrastructure
items.tagline: Underground, linear and high technical complexity coordination.
items.description: Public and private infrastructure presents unique challenges: underground electrical networks, Public Lighting, Grounding and Lightning Protection, telecommunications and traffic control systems — all coordinated under institutional standards.

story.label: Our Story
story.headline: Born from the industry. Built for the industry.
story.body:
SORA emerged from direct observation of a recurring problem in high-complexity projects: Electrical Systems, BMS, Telecommunications and Electronic Security are designed separately, modeled separately and frequently installed without coordination between each other or with the rest of the project.

We founded SORA to solve that problem at its root: as technical integrators specialized in Electrical and Special Systems under international BIM standards.
